purpose: Complete single/cumulative/removal attribution of center-surround cue contrast and the learned fusion-quality gate. A combination beating RGB is insufficient to establish both modules.

factors.S: Center-surround normalized contrast and local scale inputs of the native cue encoder
factors.Q: Learned per-pyramid global fusion-quality gate; off uses the original fixed0.5 gate

00.source: One new joint-disable fit, conditional on the original Dev-only gate

11.source: Existing normal IR fit in the frozen primary mode

fixed_across_cells: Same raw current November DiffV2IR pixels and calibration
Same RGB teacher checkpoint, encoder/head freezing and production FP16/B1 convention
Same seed0 module tensor initialization, nine encoder input channels and parameter inventory
Same original RGB confidence protection and reliable-RGB loss
Same full Train27251-frame chronological clips, schedule, optimizer and12-epoch LR horizon
Same frozen primary mode; if temporal, keep memory, flow and its quality-conditioned noise MLP
gate_scope: Quality=false removes only the feature-fusion gate MLP path. It does not remove the detached quality statistics used by temporal variance. Contrast=false preserves raw cue planes; local contrast is zero and local scale is one as in the existing removal.

fit_authorization.input: Complete six-arm normal Dev and native_pyramid_normal_selection_frozen.json only
fit_authorization.condition: Use original fit_registered_removals=True: primary IR strictly exceeds direct/fresh RGB, matched RGB and matched gray on both complete Dev videos
fit_authorization.complete_Train_epochs: Exactly the original common executed6/9/12 epoch budget
fit_authorization.if_negative: Preserve the negative normal architecture result and report this conditional extension not triggered; do not fit only because Test is attractive

selection.primary: Original parent IR primary is unchanged
policies: All four cells paired at the original primary epoch
Each cell own best from all complete Dev epochs; same HOTA/AssA/IDF1/earlier-epoch tie rule
selection.existing_cells: Reuse already frozen parent outputs when the checkpoint/condition is identical; explicitly evaluate any missing paired snapshot, never substitute another epoch

contribution_rule: Report every effect on complete Dev and Test. A module requires positive alone and conditional effects on both splits, plus strong controls, real input interventions, mechanism/prior-art distinction and full costs. These necessary contrasts do not automatically establish originality or the complete Goal.
reporting: All47 official fields, per sequence and COMBINED, original276-column CSV; use HOTA___AUC*100 from the original CSV for full-precision effect analysis. Preserve negative deltas and the exposed historical-Test limitation.

execution.order: Independent follow-up after the existing structural/native/CGR/neck72/fresh-runtime queue has completed and actual processes have exited. Do not change any active predecessor registry.
launch_requires: Actual GPU joint-disable training and source/missing identity canary
Complete original normal Dev-only fit authorization
execution.CPU_canary: Two ordered four-frame Train clips for joint-disable in each mode; no saved weights, Dev/Test labels, new seeds or accuracy

current_limitations: No new normal NativePyramid Dev curve or HOTA exists yet
This extension adds attribution conditions, not an additional fusion architecture
All named image statistics, gating and filters have established prior art
Historical Test is exposed; original RGB pretraining included current Dev
